analysis: standard model averaging of three TCGA-developed component models
combination: component predictions standardized with inner-validation mean and population SD, followed by an unweighted 1:1:1 arithmetic mean

components.mil_1024: inner-validation-selected multi-output gated-attention MIL using a 1,024-tile bag
components.mil_2048: inner-validation-selected multi-output gated-attention MIL using a 2,048-tile bag
components.retccl_pca_ridge: RetCCL patient-mean features; fold-internal standardization; PCA16; ridge alpha 100

tcga_aggregation: unweighted mean of three seed-specific outer-fold predictions
